VIUMO v1.1.2 • Final Trilogy: Part 1 🛠️

We are rolling out the first of our final three stability updates for the year, focusing entirely on making your experience flawless and reliable.

What's New:
• Rock-Solid Playback: Fixed underlying streaming bugs to eliminate playback errors.
• Smart Downloads: Faster download speeds and improved, auto-retrying file handling for network drops.
• UI Refinements: Minor interface polishes for a cleaner, snappier feel.

Enjoy a smoother, uninterrupted streaming experience!
